name: kerala-vo-1
text:
Lakhs of big houses in Kerala. [short pause] Nobody lives in them.
Shutters down. Gates chained. Courtyards still swept... by someone who doesn't live there.
The 2011 Census counted about 11.9 lakh empty houses in Kerala. About one in every ten. Over three lakh had four rooms or more.
So where did everyone go? [pause] Abroad.
About 22 lakh Keralites live overseas, most in the Gulf. In 2023 they sent home over 2 lakh crore rupees.
And much of Kerala's home building runs on that money... a big house back home, to stay rooted.
But the children move away too. In Pathanamthitta alone, officials count over 61,000 closed homes.
In 2023 the state even proposed a tax on locked houses... and dropped it within a month.
So who are these houses really for? [pause] Lakhs of big houses...
